title: You're tired
notes: Saturday morning, if you promised Dana. The outline's line: "You're tired. She'll understand." Keep it or break it. Either way, the record says which. Claude's draft.
Being tired is true. It isn't a new fact. So It's a plan change counts as a delay here, and says so.
Getting up for Dana is acting, but it isn't your daily floor, so it doesn't count toward a day of structure.
